title: The reverend John Hughes S. J.
html_source: This is the actual reverend, listed by Thom’s 1904 as a resident in the Presbytery House of the Church of St. Francis Xavier on Gardiner Street Upper, which means he would be an associate and co-resident with Father Conmee from the Wandering Rocks chapter.
